rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: Fit to be brought near, as the clean beasts taken by sevens
content.ART_PROMPT: The lamplit interior of the ark, a wicker cage of white doves and a pair of young lambs bedded on fresh straw between cedar ribs, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, night under a lantern, a warm amber pool of light in deep indigo dark
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Name a card type. Choose another player; that chosen player puts one card of the named type from that chosen player's hand into Sheol, then draw two cards from the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 7:2 — “Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Matthew 5:8 — “Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: The clean and unclean distinction appears in Genesis 7, generations before any law names which beasts are which.
Noah takes clean beasts by sevens precisely because he will sacrifice some of them when he lands.
Katharos gives English catharsis; the same root covers a scrubbed pot and a clean conscience.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
